specification.title: Irrelevant retrieved context is never auto-promoted
specification.description: Retrieved-but-irrelevant context: the model deterministically returns claims=() so retrieval is never automatically promoted to claims.
specification.purpose: Verify retrieved-but-irrelevant context deterministically yields zero claims instead of automatic promotion to persisted claims.
specification.operational_relevance: Retrieval relevance does not equal claim-worthiness; auto-promotion would flood investigations with garbage claims.
specification.regression_risk: The agent could promote retrieved chunks into claims without a model decision.

required: The persisted result declares the empty outcome for irrelevant context
forbidden: Retrieved context is automatically promoted into claims
